coin.title: “175 years of the Federal Constitution” Gold coin
coin.description: The 11.29g special coin marking 175 years of the Federal Constitution is alloyed with 0.900 gold and shows the preamble of the Federal Constitution on the obverse – symbolically transposed with the terms of the text intertwining to form a very powerful symbol. The reverse features an angel bears the the Swiss coat of arms. Further to the discussions about the reference to God in the Federal Constitution, the Olten artist Peter Salzmann left out the wings from the angel. “We usually see what we want to see – and so we are left with a figure that is familiar to us. The angel becomes Helvetia, the peacemaker. A virtue that is more important than ever in today’s world,” explained Salzmann.

specs.Mintage Proof in presentation case: 3,750 units Proof in presentation case with certificate from the artist: 250 units Coin box numbered with silver coin: 1000 units
